summary.headline: Ashapura Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 19.2% to INR1,616 crore, but EBITDA was flat at INR188.9 crore and margin fell to 11.7%.
summary.overview: Consolidated income from operations rose about 19% YoY to INR1,616 crore, while reported EBITDA was broadly flat at INR188.9 crore as higher fuel, marine freight and input costs absorbed the gain. PBT declined about 1.4% YoY to INR130.03 crore and EPS rose to INR12.07 from INR11.5. Guinea bauxite volumes fell to 2.34 million tons from 3.16 million tons in Q4, with bauxite EBITDA per ton rising to USD6.3 from USD5.9. India businesses were hit by fuel, freight and sulphuric acid costs, with the bleaching clay JV under the most pressure.

financial_highlights.change: vs 3.16 mt in Q4 and 2.05 mt in Q1 FY26

segments.name: Guinea bauxite and iron ore
segments.commentary: Turnover about INR1,360 crore (84% of group) and EBITDA INR163 crore; volumes 2.34 mt, EBITDA USD6.3/t. Iron ore is in trial production with revenue not disclosed and EBITDA reported is bauxite-only.

segments.name: India bentonite and allied minerals / white performance minerals
segments.commentary: Wholly owned; bentonite broadly stable with domestic growth offsetting weaker exports, while white performance minerals profitability was hit by higher sales and distribution costs. No segment figures given.

segments.name: Bleaching clay (Ashapura Perfoclay, 50% JV)
segments.commentary: Sulphuric acid, a key raw material, rose about five-fold over the past year to above INR30/kg, adversely affecting the business. No figures given.

segments.name: Advanced ceramics (Orient Ceratech, 32%)
segments.commentary: Management said segment EBITDA more than doubled on premium product mix, oil and gas demand and steel-industry materials. No figures given.

guidance_outlook: FY27 bauxite volume target of 10-12 million tons retained with a potential variance of ±10% (about 9-11 mt); Q2 is seasonally weakest, with most sales in late Q3 and Q4.
Bauxite EBITDA per ton expected near USD6 (USD5.5-6 range) for the next one or two quarters; return toward ~USD10 is a medium to long-term expectation, timing not predicted.
Iron ore: 15 million ton target by FY28 reaffirmed ("achieve or even cross"), but long-term iron ore guidance needs a couple more quarters.
Guinea export quota system expected before end of CY2026, seen as supportive of realisations and freight.
Management expects bauxite revenue near USD1 billion (about INR10,000 crore) at 15 mt once conditions normalise.
India capex of close to INR200 crore planned across projects and verticals.
capex_capacity: Boffa port fully operational with capacity raised from 5 mtpa to 8 mtpa; no further expansion to 10-12 mt planned near-term, to be decided as volumes ramp.
GSM second port new jetty under construction, expected operational by Q4 FY27, raising capacity from 6 mtpa to 10 mtpa; combined port capacity about 23 mt.
Total bauxite export capacity stated at 18 million tons.
Bauxite washing plant set up with ~20,000 tons/day capacity, on an operate-and-transfer model; a comparable plant would cost about USD15 million and take about one year to build if expanded.
Ashapura has over 1 million tons of bentonite grinding capacity, which management described as the world's largest.
demand_pricing: Freight remains highly volatile and elevated; management expects volatility through 2027 and freight is the main margin overhang.
Chinese index bauxite price around USD72/t, up from ~USD61, mostly due to ocean freight rather than FOB Guinea price.
Alumina prices under pressure; management is positive on medium-term demand, citing four new Chinese refineries adding 20-30 mt of bauxite demand.
Middle East and Europe customer demand impacted by geopolitics and freight; company focusing on India, Asia and Africa.
Customer demand volatile; customers may take time to absorb market and cost changes.

qa_highlights.question: Status and timing of Guinea bauxite export quota system and expected realisations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects the quota system before end of 2026 and sees realisations flat until then; margins also flat with freight overhang. FY28 15 mt target described as on track.

qa_highlights.question: Response to new entrants such as Nimba selling bauxite via monthly tenders?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is a new development with slow materialisation and will not significantly disrupt the market, with volumes likely going to other traders; Ashapura may participate in tenders.

qa_highlights.question: Impact and expansion of the washing plant on EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the plant is roughly EBITDA neutral and mainly a sustainability and throughput tool; no EBITDA quantification given; expansion would take about one year.

qa_highlights.question: Boffa port expansion beyond 8 mt to 10 mt by Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: No near-term plan; 8 mt is seen as reasonable for now, with expansion to 10-12 mt to follow volume ramp-up without a fixed timeline.

qa_highlights.question: Fako deposit and China Railway arrangement?
qa_highlights.answer: Only an MOU; details under study and little progress to report, with possible update next year.

qa_highlights.question: Why no iron ore revenue disclosure, and is the 10 mt guidance achievable?
qa_highlights.answer: Iron ore is in trial production with low revenue, so it is not split out; EBITDA disclosed is bauxite only. Guidance is 10-12 mt with ±10% variance, and management said it is broadly on track.

qa_highlights.question: EBITDA per ton outlook for Q2, FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Near-term USD5.5-6/t; a return toward USD10/t is expected over the medium to longer term, timing uncertain.

qa_highlights.question: Drivers of Orient Ceratech's EBITDA doubling and India growth levers?
qa_highlights.answer: Drivers are oil and gas product demand with debottlenecking and steel-industry materials replacing imports; India growth from cat litter, foundry, oil and gas, and kaolin for paper and paint.
